title: Pure Clown Crew
summary: Clown Crew cards with generic hand traps and staples. The Clown Crew Spells and Traps summon Ritual, Fusion, Synchro, Xyz and Link Clown Crews straight from the Deck or Extra Deck, ignoring their conditions, and Biancaviso Tributes them for draws or negates; every Clown Crew pays you back when it is Tributed. Cappello, the newest card, is a Pendulum one-card starter: from the Scale it mills a Clown Crew card to summon itself, and when it is Tributed it summons a Clown Crew from the Deck or Extra Deck. Most summons stop you activating the effects of monsters summoned from the Deck or Extra Deck until your next turn, so the plan is to Tribute them rather than use them.
main: Newest support. From the Scale, mills a Clown Crew card to summon itself; Tributed, summons a Clown Crew from the Deck or Extra Deck.
Tribute Summoned off a Ritual, Fusion, Synchro, Xyz, Pendulum or Link: draws or negates per Tribute, and Tribute Summons on their turn.
Ritual: reveals itself to search a Clown Crew card; Tributed, flips a monster face-down or clears Rituals.
Tributes a monster to add Biancaviso and a Clown Crew Spell/Trap; from the GY, Ritual Summons Flair.
Quick-Play: summons two Clown Crews from the Deck or Extra Deck; from the GY, Tributes to bounce a card.
Summons a Clown Crew each turn and draws for every card type you Tributed.
Summons two Clown Crews or searches one; from the GY, Tribute Summons on the spot.
Discards to destroy that many face-up cards; from the GY, Tributes to search a Clown Crew monster.
Destroys Spells/Traps for each monster you Tribute; recycles three Clown Crew cards for a draw.
extra: Synchro: your Tribute Summons can't be answered; Tributed, returns a Clown Crew card.
Fusion: double piercing for your Tribute Summoned monster; Tributed, Sets a Clown Crew Trap.
Rank 3: +1000 ATK for your Tribute Summoned monsters; Tributed, Sets a Clown Crew Spell.
Link-2: your Tribute Summoned monsters attack twice; Tributed, resets both hands.
